title: Actual Budget
descript: Actual Budget is a local-first personal finance app: a fast, private envelope budget that runs on your NAS and syncs with the desktop and mobile apps. Track accounts, plan the next month, import bank statements and read reports - no subscription and no cloud account. Every budget file stays in the application data folder on your own device.
release_note: 1. First release: Actual Budget 26.11.0 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Local-first budgeting with desktop/mobile sync, all data in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). Open the web UI, set a server password on first use, then create a budget file; all data lives in DockerAppData/actualbudgetdocker/data. Point the desktop or mobile app at the same URL to sync. The UI is plain HTTP - put it behind a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet. Back up the data folder before uninstalling with data removal.

zh-cn.descript: Actual Budget 是一款本地优先的个人记账应用：快速、私密的信封预算法，跑在自家 NAS 上，并与桌面端、手机端（含 PWA）同步。可以管理账户、规划下个月、导入银行流水、查看报表，没有订阅、也不依赖云账号。所有预算文件都保存在应用数据目录里。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。打开界面后先设置服务器密码，再新建预算文件；数据都保存在 DockerAppData/actualbudgetdocker/data。桌面端/手机端填同一个地址即可同步。界面为纯 HTTP，暴露到公网前请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。卸载并删除数据前请先备份 data 目录。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 Actual Budget 26.11.0，以非 root 容器运行。本地优先记账，支持桌面端/手机端同步，数据全部保存在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: Actual Budget 是一款本地優先的個人記帳應用：快速、私密的信封預算法，跑在自家 NAS 上，並與桌面端、手機端（含 PWA）同步。可以管理帳戶、規劃下個月、匯入銀行流水、查看報表，沒有訂閱、也不依賴雲端帳號。所有預算檔案都保存在應用資料目錄裡。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。開啟介面後先設定伺服器密碼，再建立預算檔案；資料都保存在 DockerAppData/actualbudgetdocker/data。桌面端/手機端填同一個位址即可同步。介面為純 HTTP，公開到互聯網前請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。解除安裝並刪除資料前請先備份 data 目錄。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 Actual Budget 26.11.0，以非 root 容器運行。本地優先記帳，支援桌面端/手機端同步，資料全部保存在應用資料目錄。

data_notes: `/data` (mounted from `/Volume1/DockerAppData/actualbudgetdocker/data`) holds the server files and every budget file you create: `server-files/` keeps the sync state and `user-files/` the budgets and uploaded statements.
design_notes: **No database server.** Actual stores budgets in SQLite files under `/data`; the container starts as uid 1000 and needs nothing else.
**One volume, one port.** Only `/data` is persistent and only container port 5006 is published.
**Interpreter healthcheck.** The image ships neither curl nor wget, so the healthcheck asks the bundled Node runtime to fetch the start page.
limitations: - The web UI is served over plain HTTP on the published port; use a TLS reverse proxy if you expose it outside your LAN.
- The server has no account system by default - set the server password on first use, otherwise anyone who can reach the port can open your budgets.
- The data folder is not visible in TOS File Manager; back it up over SMB/SSH or add the path to a TOS backup task.
